artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Tracked read-only derivation module: the account_return_daily method as pure functions over the Inflection silver frames; reads only through the round-108 GET-only reader; no write-call name; every s3:// literal under a granted Inflection prefix (none typed); names no other firm; not deployed.
11 offline tests on synthetic data, 11 passed under python -I -m pytest -q; a temporary flow-window mutant failed 2 of them and was reverted byte-identical.

The round-109 record: module, engine (unchanged), tests, derived table and gaps file (private, hashed), the per-window counts and the basis words; counts, hashes and words only; files_in_repo, served_values_changed, pushed and deployed all false.
Five surprise rows IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W174-S1 to S5 appended as bytes, one fenced json block each, UNDER_INVESTIGATION.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: DB109-3-AC1 -- the module is a tracked file hashed as recorded, names no other firm and holds no write call, every `s3://` literal sits under a granted Inflection prefix; the engine file is hashed as it stands and is unchanged from HEAD; the test file has 6 or more passing tests and passes when the checker runs it, with a failing mutant; the checker calls `daily_returns` and `window_return` on a synthetic week with a closed day that carries a deposit and finds them equal to its own independent computation (the closed day's flow carried to the next trading day, a missing value gives None, never zero, the window return the product); the derived table is a private parquet outside the repo, hashed as recorded, its own schema hash equals the account_return_daily contract's, its accounts are Inflection accounts of the dry run and `derived.rows` and `derived.accounts` equal the checker's recount; label OPAL_COMPUTED; the tie-out gaps file is a private parquet with exactly one row per household of the dry run per window, every household without a gap carries a reason, the record's compared, not-comparable and bin counts equal the checker's recount per window, at least one window compares at least one client, and no tolerance is assumed; nothing is written; no push or deploy. Base: FAIL (no record).
acceptance.output_evidence:
OK: the TWR method equals the checker's independent computation (closed-day deposit carried to the next day, missing value gives None); 926 derived accounts, 878047 rows (label OPAL_COMPUTED, schema hash equal to the contract's); tie-out over 320 households in 4 windows, bins recounted, no tolerance assumed
DB109-3-AC1 PASS
acceptance.denominator: 1 of 1 criterion; 926 of 980 dry-run accounts derived into 878047 account-day rows (54 accounts hold no positive value and have no rows); 320 households x 4 windows = 1280 gap rows, 287 of 320 compared in quarter-to-date and 0 of 320 in each of the other three windows (the gap in the positions silver: 2026-07-01, 2026-09-28); 11 of 11 tests passed, mutant caught

mutant.description: Temporary edit of the module's flow window to sum only the trading day's own flows (d == t), the failure the skipped-day rule exists to catch; run with the offline tests; the module restored byte-identical afterwards.
mutant.expected: at least one test fails under the mutant
mutant.observed: 2 of 11 tests failed under the mutant (the skipped-day deposit test and the derived-row carry test); 11 of 11 passed after the revert, module sha256 unchanged

determinism.method: The issuer checker run twice on the final tree, whole printed output compared.
determinism.observed: identical output on both runs: the same OK line and DB109-3-AC1 PASS, rc 0 both times

surprises: IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W174-S1: account_return_daily describes account_id as a 10-character zero-padded custodian id; Orion accountId is not zero-padded, so the derived table keeps the account_dim form (a meaning mismatch, not a schema impossibility; the contract is outside the grant).

IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W174-S2: BLOCKING. fact_positions has no partition for two NYSE trading days (2026-07-01, 2026-09-28); the YTD, last-12-month and since-inception windows read not comparable for every household; quarter-to-date compares 287 of 320.

IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W174-S3: Orion partitions are calendar-daily, so carried_days is 3 on Mondays rather than 1 on ordinary days, and the engine's link through intervening valuations is not applied (the endpoint form the TO states).
IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W174-S4: a computed derived day reads day_quality MEASURED with guard_state GUARD_NOT_REACHED because the enums have no member for computed-but-unguarded.
IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W174-S5: 19,390 positions rows with isActive false carry non-zero currentValue; the silver defines no isActive; the value basis includes them until the CTO rules.
